template: Relocation payments for owner/relative move-in, demolition/removal, temporary capital improvement and substantial rehabilitation evictions would cover this address but is not yet in effect; it takes effect on 2026-03-01. Source: San Francisco Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C; as of 2025-12-31. Not legal advice.
rewrite: The relocation payment rule for evictions because an owner or relative is moving in, the unit is being demolished or removed, or the unit needs temporary capital improvements or substantial rehabilitation would apply to this address, but it is not in effect yet and starts on 2026-03-01. Source: San Francisco Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C; as of 2025-12-31. Not legal advice.
